programme.title: THE LEGEND OF HEROES
programme.desc: Qiu Qianren, sekutu tentera Jin, muncul untuk mendesak Lu Chengfeng membebaskan Yang Kang. Dia berbohong bahawa Huang Yaoshi, iaitu ayah Huang Rong yang juga sifu kepada Lu Chengfeng dan Mei Chaofeng, telah meninggal dunia.

programme.title: AMUSING RACE SEASON 2
programme.desc: Episod ini hos bersaing di Sepang Golden Palm Tree Resort dalam aksi bola tampar pantai dan bersalto di dalam lumpur. Pemenang mendapat ganjaran spak mewah, manakala yang kalah terpaksa berdepan hukuman memakan kulit buah naga.

programme.title: GREAT TIMES
programme.desc: Chee Qian insaf dan menyerah diri kepada pihak polis atas kes yang mengaitkan kematian ibunya. Ruo Lan dimasukkan ke hospital selepas kesan pengambilan pil pengguguran. Ekoran itu Ruo Lan mengalami gangguan emosi.

programme.title: ANONYMOUS SIGNAL
programme.desc: Chun Long dan Ka Lei membuat persiapan untuk majlis perkahwinan. Zhi Yi akhirnya mengetahui bahawa Lau Wai Fong adalah ibu sebenarnya. Namun Zhi Yi sedih kerana tidak mahu berpisah dengan Chun Long dan Kal Lei.

programme.title: THE PROMISE
programme.desc: Pada suatu malam dengan hujan ribut petir, Zheng Guo dan Wen An menyelamatkan Shao Ting yang telah cedera parah. Berjayakah mereka menyelamatkan dia dan dapatkah Shao Ting kembali ke zaman moden?

programme.title: FIGHT FOR JUSTICE (1 - 250)
programme.desc: Keluarga Zai Xing menghadapi masalah besar dari Syarikat KY Motor dan projek pembangunan Kumpulan Yong Xing. Zai Xing yang risau di tenangkan hati oleh An Jie. Sementara itu, bapa anak Zhou Lai Fa dan Zheng Zhe ditangkap oleh orang Qian Kun.

programme.title: FIGHT FOR JUSTICE (1 - 250)
programme.desc: Jia Feng menjemput Jing Yi ke pejabatnya bersama Ivan bagi menzahirkan rasa terima kasih atas bantuan di pejabat Chang Sheng. Kesempatan itu digunakan Jia Feng untuk merayu agar hubungan suami isteri mereka dapat dipulihkan.

programme.title: HEROES IN WHITE
programme.desc: Sai-hang menculik Wing-sum dan Yee-ting. Sai-hang menuntut wang tebusan HK$10 juta daripada Wai-man dan memberi amaran kepadanya jangan menghubungi polis. Wai-man dan Yin-cho pergi ke lokasi pertukaran dengan wang tebusan.

programme.title: MY STAR FAMILY 3
programme.desc: Keira berasa skeptikal apabila diberitahu bahawa Mr Toh, penaja yang bersikap dominan, sekali lagi menjadi penaja utama drama baharunya. Dia mendapati bahawa Mr Toh telah dimanipulasi oleh seorang lelaki kononnya mentor kerohanian.

programme.title: THE LEGEND OF HEROES
programme.desc: Guo Jing mendapati makanan dan penginapannya di sepanjang perjalanan telah diatur oleh orang yang tidak diketahui. Dia meninggalkan Yang Kang untuk mencari Huang Rong dan mendapati dia adalah orang yang membuat pengaturan tersebut.

programme.title: HO CHAK! 2025/2026
programme.desc: Episod ini hos Orange Tan mengunjungi 3 buah restoran di kawasan Lembah Klang untuk memperkenal dan menikmati masakan istimewa dan sedap. Antaranya Restoran Saga Highland di Tmn Saga, Ampang, Selangor dan Kech Kitchen KL di Jln Ampang.

programme.title: GREAT TIMES
programme.desc: Huan Run memberitahu Jia Mei bahawa Chiu Yeh sudah tahu Jia Ming menjual maklumat sulit syarikat kepada pesaing. Jia Ming membawa Jia Mei berjumpa pembeli tetapi Chiu Yeh dan sepasukan anggota polis tiba tepat pada waktunya.

programme.title: ANONYMOUS SIGNAL
programme.desc: Lau Wai Fong diculik oleh Ling Lek. ASIB menyiasat identiti Ling Lek dan mendapati beliau adalah seorang pemunuh upahan dari sebuah negara Sakapia. Ling Lek aktif di kawasan Asia Tenggara dan terlibat dalam beberapa kes pembunuhan.

programme.title: FIGHT FOR JUSTICE (1 - 250)
programme.desc: Jia Feng menjemput Jing Yi ke pejabatnya bersama Ivan bagi menzahirkan rasa terima kasih atas bantuan di pejabat Chang Sheng. Kesempatan itu digunakan Jia Feng untuk merayu agar hubungan suami isteri mereka dapat dipulihkan.

programme.title: FIGHT FOR JUSTICE (1 - 250)
programme.desc: Berita kemalangan tragis membabitkan Jia Feng dan Jing Yi mengejutkan Chang Sheng. Di tengah kekecohan mencari komputer Jia Feng, Chang Sheng mengarahkan Dong Jun dan Ya Jie mengejar An Jie untuk memusnahkan bukti.

programme.title: THE GREATEST OF US
programme.desc: Rancangan muzik 'variety show' menampilkan 3 penyanyi, yang merupakan peserta tetap bersama-sama 7 lagi penyanyi jemputan akan mempersembahkan lagu-lagu yang popular dari pelbagai era untuk menghiburkan para penonton.

programme.title: TILL THE END OF THE MOON
programme.desc: Tai Jin kecewa mendapati Xi Wu cuba meracuninya demi menyelamatkan Xiao Lin. Xi Wu telah dipukau oleh Tai Jin dengan kuasa ajaibnya tiba-tiba menikam Xiao Lin. Xiao Lin yang cedera parah sempat menulis surat kepada Tai Jin

programme.title: Grand Song of the Dong - Natural Oriental Harmony
programme.desc: The Grand Song of the Dong is a polyphonic folk singing tradition of the Dong ethnic group. Performers from several villages gather together to sing, unaccompanied. The songs, which describe the history, beliefs, customs, and emotions of the Dong people, are an important part of their cultural identity and contribute significantly to their social cohesion. Generally sung in the Dong language, which has no written form, they are passed on orally from one generation to the next. Classified into various genres - including narrative and love songs, drinking and funeral songs - they are often accompanied by clapping, stomping, and dancing. Sung on occasions such as festivals, weddings, and funerals, the Grand Song, as a valuable part of the Dong ethnic group's cultural heritage, reflects their wisdom and creativity, as well as their harmony with nature.

programme.title: China Untapped: Huzhou
programme.desc: Located in the east of China, on the south shore of Taihu Lake, Huzhou has been well-known for its richness in resources and blooming in silk trade since the ancient times. Guided by the concept of "lucid waters and lush mountains are invaluable assets", Huzhou now is committed to developing green industries. In this episode, CGTN hosts Tianran He and Hannah Wilson travelled to Huzhou, where they tried a variety of guesthouse hotels in the Moganshan Mountains; experienced the life of digital nomads in Anji's countryside; learned about the eco-concepts behind China's traditional architectures in Nanxun Ancient Town; and explored the development of eco-agriculture powered by high-tech along the Taihu Lake. All these phenomena demonstrate that economic development and environmental protection can achieve harmonious coexistence, and that civilization thrives if ecology is prosperous.

programme.title: Ad Break

programme.title: Grand Song of the Dong - Natural Oriental Harmony
programme.desc: The Grand Song of the Dong is a polyphonic folk singing tradition of the Dong ethnic group. Performers from several villages gather together to sing, unaccompanied. The songs, which describe the history, beliefs, customs, and emotions of the Dong people, are an important part of their cultural identity and contribute significantly to their social cohesion. Generally sung in the Dong language, which has no written form, they are passed on orally from one generation to the next. Classified into various genres - including narrative and love songs, drinking and funeral songs - they are often accompanied by clapping, stomping, and dancing. Sung on occasions such as festivals, weddings, and funerals, the Grand Song, as a valuable part of the Dong ethnic group's cultural heritage, reflects their wisdom and creativity, as well as their harmony with nature.

Sung on occasions such as festivals, weddings, and funerals, the Grand Song, as a valuable part of the Dong ethnic group's cultural heritage, reflects their wisdom and creativity, as well as their harmony with nature.

programme.title: China Untapped: Huzhou
programme.desc: Located in the east of China, on the south shore of Taihu Lake, Huzhou has been well-known for its richness in resources and blooming in silk trade since the ancient times. Guided by the concept of "lucid waters and lush mountains are invaluable assets", Huzhou now is committed to developing green industries. In this episode, CGTN hosts Tianran He and Hannah Wilson travelled to Huzhou, where they tried a variety of guesthouse hotels in the Moganshan Mountains; experienced the life of digital nomads in Anji's countryside; learned about the eco-concepts behind China's traditional architectures in Nanxun Ancient Town; and explored the development of eco-agriculture powered by high-tech along the Taihu Lake. All these phenomena demonstrate that economic development and environmental protection can achieve harmonious coexistence, and that civilization thrives if ecology is prosperous.

programme.title: From Stone to Story
programme.desc: China's profound stone carving culture dates back to the Han Dynasty (202 BC - 220 AD) and flourished during the Tang Dynasty (618 - 907 AD), evolving into a distinctive art form and unique cultural practice. Among many places famous for stone carving, Hui'an County - through generations of dedicated artisans - has risen to prominence and earned the esteemed title of "World Capital of Stone Carving," awarded by the World Crafts Council. The county's skilled stonemasons are celebrated for their ability to transform ordinary pieces of rock into beautiful works of art. This episode shines a spotlight on the intangible cultural heritage of Hui'an stone carving and reveals how it has been influenced by the area's close proximity to the sea.

programme.title: From Stone to Story
programme.desc: China's profound stone carving culture dates back to the Han Dynasty (202 BC - 220 AD) and flourished during the Tang Dynasty (618 - 907 AD), evolving into a distinctive art form and unique cultural practice. Among many places famous for stone carving, Hui'an County - through generations of dedicated artisans - has risen to prominence and earned the esteemed title of "World Capital of Stone Carving," awarded by the World Crafts Council. The county's skilled stonemasons are celebrated for their ability to transform ordinary pieces of rock into beautiful works of art. This episode shines a spotlight on the intangible cultural heritage of Hui'an stone carving and reveals how it has been influenced by the area's close proximity to the sea.

programme.title: The Taste of Yunnan Ep.5
programme.desc: This ten-part documentary introduces the food of Yunnan, from the opening chapters "Family Feast in Spring" and "Simple Joys" to the nostalgic "Times Past" and "Love Away from Home." While each chapter seems to stand alone, they share a common core. Unlike conventional food documentaries, The Taste of Yunnan leaps across the region and avoids categorizing by locality or dish. Instead, every episode follows its own protagonists: the Zheng Hongwei brothers harvesting water bamboo shoots in Jianshui; Yang Jimei's family gathering toon sprouts at the foot of Jizu Mountain in Binchuan, Dali; and Wang Jinghua, a young man of the Nu ethnic group who still makes the traditional Nujiang dish "chicken cooked in lacquer tree oil" entirely by hand. Through its plain yet detailed portrayal of food and its subtle understanding of the relationship between people and ingredients, the series is much more than a food documentary. It challenges the old misperception that Yunnan cuisine lacks cultural depth, showing that its heritage is humble and simple - found in a piece of Heqing's secret-recipe blown liver from Dali, or in a jar of Yinji pickles from Weishan.

programme.title: Life as a Miao Silversmith
programme.desc: In this episode, Eva May steps into Maliao Village - a century-old silversmith village nestled in Leishan, Guizhou Province. Over the course of a week, she dives into the craft and daily lives of Miao men who carry on the silversmithing legacy. She works side by side with local silversmiths day in and day out, delving into the culture and techniques behind Miao silverware. She even joins master silversmiths for a live-stream event, before engaging in discussions with university professors about how traditional craftsmanship can fuel rural revitalization. On top of that, she witnesses the breathtaking sight of "maidens adorned in silver and flowers" at the grand Miao New Year celebrations, visits Xijiang Qianhu Miaozhai - the world's largest Miao village - and learns to forge a small yet meaningful piece of Miao silver ornament.

programme.title: All About the Yak
programme.desc: In this episode, we go to Nangqian, Yushu, Qinghai Province, to get close contact with the Yak in Tibet, which is known as the " Vehicle on the Plateau". As the journey continues, we are able to understand several aspects of the yak culture which is closely related to the life of Tibetan people.

programme.title: The Taste of Yunnan Ep.5
programme.desc: This ten-part documentary introduces the food of Yunnan, from the opening chapters "Family Feast in Spring" and "Simple Joys" to the nostalgic "Times Past" and "Love Away from Home." While each chapter seems to stand alone, they share a common core. Unlike conventional food documentaries, The Taste of Yunnan leaps across the region and avoids categorizing by locality or dish. Instead, every episode follows its own protagonists: the Zheng Hongwei brothers harvesting water bamboo shoots in Jianshui; Yang Jimei's family gathering toon sprouts at the foot of Jizu Mountain in Binchuan, Dali; and Wang Jinghua, a young man of the Nu ethnic group who still makes the traditional Nujiang dish "chicken cooked in lacquer tree oil" entirely by hand. Through its plain yet detailed portrayal of food and its subtle understanding of the relationship between people and ingredients, the series is much more than a food documentary. It challenges the old misperception that Yunnan cuisine lacks cultural depth, showing that its heritage is humble and simple - found in a piece of Heqing's secret-recipe blown liver from Dali, or in a jar of Yinji pickles from Weishan.

programme.title: Life as a Miao Silversmith
programme.desc: In this episode, Eva May steps into Maliao Village - a century-old silversmith village nestled in Leishan, Guizhou Province. Over the course of a week, she dives into the craft and daily lives of Miao men who carry on the silversmithing legacy. She works side by side with local silversmiths day in and day out, delving into the culture and techniques behind Miao silverware. She even joins master silversmiths for a live-stream event, before engaging in discussions with university professors about how traditional craftsmanship can fuel rural revitalization. On top of that, she witnesses the breathtaking sight of "maidens adorned in silver and flowers" at the grand Miao New Year celebrations, visits Xijiang Qianhu Miaozhai - the world's largest Miao village - and learns to forge a small yet meaningful piece of Miao silver ornament.

programme.title: The Taste of Yunnan Ep.7
programme.desc: This ten-part documentary introduces the food of Yunnan, from the opening chapters "Family Feast in Spring" and "Simple Joys" to the nostalgic "Times Past" and "Love Away from Home." While each chapter seems to stand alone, they share a common core. Unlike conventional food documentaries, The Taste of Yunnan leaps across the region and avoids categorizing by locality or dish. Instead, every episode follows its own protagonists: the Zheng Hongwei brothers harvesting water bamboo shoots in Jianshui; Yang Jimei's family gathering toon sprouts at the foot of Jizu Mountain in Binchuan, Dali; and Wang Jinghua, a young man of the Nu ethnic group who still makes the traditional Nujiang dish "chicken cooked in lacquer tree oil" entirely by hand. Through its plain yet detailed portrayal of food and its subtle understanding of the relationship between people and ingredients, the series is much more than a food documentary. It challenges the old misperception that Yunnan cuisine lacks cultural depth, showing that its heritage is humble and simple - found in a piece of Heqing's secret-recipe blown liver from Dali, or in a jar of Yinji pickles from Weishan.

programme.title: Yangliuqing New Year Painting Art
programme.desc: On May 20, 2006, Yangliuqing New Year Paintings were named as part of China's national intangible cultural heritage. The New Year painting tradition can be traced back many centuries, to the Ming Dynasty and beyond, reaching the height of its popularity in the Qing Dynasty. There are no restrictions on the themes of the paintings, and there is no blessing they cannot convey. Yangliuqing New Year Paintings are loved all over the country for their beautiful details and vivid colors - but most of all, for the good wishes they impart to anyone who sees them.

programme.title: The Taste of Yunnan Ep.7
programme.desc: This ten-part documentary introduces the food of Yunnan, from the opening chapters "Family Feast in Spring" and "Simple Joys" to the nostalgic "Times Past" and "Love Away from Home." While each chapter seems to stand alone, they share a common core. Unlike conventional food documentaries, The Taste of Yunnan leaps across the region and avoids categorizing by locality or dish. Instead, every episode follows its own protagonists: the Zheng Hongwei brothers harvesting water bamboo shoots in Jianshui; Yang Jimei's family gathering toon sprouts at the foot of Jizu Mountain in Binchuan, Dali; and Wang Jinghua, a young man of the Nu ethnic group who still makes the traditional Nujiang dish "chicken cooked in lacquer tree oil" entirely by hand. Through its plain yet detailed portrayal of food and its subtle understanding of the relationship between people and ingredients, the series is much more than a food documentary. It challenges the old misperception that Yunnan cuisine lacks cultural depth, showing that its heritage is humble and simple - found in a piece of Heqing's secret-recipe blown liver from Dali, or in a jar of Yinji pickles from Weishan.

programme.title: Young star on green field
programme.desc: Meet Sun Chenxi, a 12-year-old soccer "star" from Ningbo who first picked up the game at the age of four and is already playing with the confidence of a veteran. Sun says he dreams of turning pro one day and leading China's men's team to the World Cup. Dribbling and passing with skills far more advanced than his age, he has won over audiences far and wide after his father posted clips of Sun flashing his fancy footwork on social media. The soon-to-be-teenager now has millions of followers online. Already recognized as a rising young talent, high hopes are pinned on Sun as he is cheered on by his parents, friends, and throngs of fans online.

programme.title: I'M LIVE - MONNI
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is one of Korea's top bands MONNI! Composed of vocalist Kim Shin-eui bassist Lee In-kyoung guitarist Kong Tae-woo and drummer Jung Hun-tae the quartet made their debut in 2005 with the album One Day Light. Thanks to their outstanding musicality they quickly became known in the underground scene and soon impressed the general public through the music shows I'm A Singer Season 3 Immortal Songs: Singing the Legend King of Mask Singer and more. After a break of 7 years they released their fifth full-length album firmament in November this year. Capturing everything up in the sky from the sun to the moon to stars and light it offers a beautiful depiction of the band's identity that they have built for 17 years. In this episode MONNI performs Romantic Breeze Just so-so Tonight LOVESound as well as their new songs You were my star and Again. Tune in to I'm LIVE and check out their new releases!

programme.title: I'M LIVE - sogumm
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is sogumm famous for her unique voice and heartfelt music! This artist made herself known to the public through one TV competition show in 2019. Thanks to her wide musical spectrum and outstanding producing skills she won the competition and soon joined the record label AOMG. Of course she continued to pleasantly surprised listeners under the label. Her first album Sobrightttttttt earned both critical and commercial success and that success led her to win the coveted Rookie Prize at the 17th Korean Music Awards. She has also collaborated with a numner of A-list artists including ZICO Oh Hyuk 10CM DJ Wegun and Hoody and her ever-evolving artistry definitely makes us anticipate her future as a musician. In October this year sogumm released her full-length album Precious securing her unique spot in the industry. In this episode sogumm performs Insecurity Prescription Precious and more to show off the essence of her artistry. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet this talented musician!

programme.title: I'M LIVE - nokdu
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is risking city-pop songwriter nokdu! nokdu made his big debut in 2018 with the single Say My Name. As a graduate of The Liverpool Institute for Performing Arts founded by Paul McCartney and Mark Featherstone-Witty he covers a wide range of genres in his music ranging from Brit-pop to punk to R&B. Backed up by his academic background he boasts his outstanding ability not only as a songwriter but also a lyricist producer and singer. Also known for his stage manners he is quickly capturing the ears and souls of countless listeners. Currently he's taking part in the competition program Super Band 2. His fantastic performance in the show definitely makes us anticipate his future as a musician. In this episode nokdu performs Stay With Me Wona and more to show off the essence of his artistry. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet this talented artist!

programme.title: I'M LIVE - WeAreYoung
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is the sensual pop-duo WeAreYoung! Composed of keyboardist and vocalist KIM Kyung-min and guitarist and vocalist GU Ki-hoon this duo made themselves known to the public with their heartfelt songs about youth and love. Thanks to their outstanding musicality they won the 2017 Shinhan Card Rookie Award the Silver Prize at the 2017 Martin Contest and Best Rookie at the Beautiful Mint Life 2018. This year they were chosen as recipients of the MUSE ON 2021 which aims to connect musicians and fans during the COVID-19 pandemic. Earlier this year WeAreYoung announced their much-anticipated comeback after completing their mandatory military duties and they are bound to impress once again with their songs A Day Full Of You Let's not do that Only I Love You and more. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet these two talented musicians!

programme.title: I'M LIVE - Lee Jin ah
programme.desc: I'm LIVE presents three special episodes in commemoration of the end of the year and having a live audience for the first time in 2 years! programme.title: I'M LIVE - Younha
programme.desc: Joining us on this week’s I’m LIVE is singer-songwriter Younha! Younha began her career in 2003 in Japan with her first single “ゆびきり.” Then she found mainstream success the following year with her second Japanese single “ほうき星 (Comet)” which was included on the soundtrack of the anime series “Bleach.” The song peaked on the Oricon Chart at #15 giving her the nickname of the “Oricon Comet.” Her success in the island country led to her debut in Korea as well; she debuted in Korea in 2016 where she is regarded as one of the country’s best singer-songwriters. From “Waiting” to “Password 486” Younha has many hit songs under her belt. She has also collaborated with numerous A-list musicians including Toy and Epik High. In November last year Younha released her sixth full-length album “END THEORY” to once again prove how versatile of a musician she is. From rock to ballad music she covered various genres in the album and the album’s lead single “Stardust” was chosen as one of Billboard’s Best K-pop Songs of the Year. In this episode Younha performs “Stardust” “Wish” “Waiting” “How U doing” and more to nourish our hearts. Tune in to I’m LIVE and meet this talented artist!

programme.title: I'M LIVE - Kuonechan
programme.desc: Kuonechan is a rising star in Korean R&B circles known for his sweet voice and heartwarming music. After debuting in the music scene with the EP “Repetition” in September 2017 he diligently pursued his career releasing a total of three EPs within a year. He’s now actively collaborating with big names in the industry including Baek Yerin Jang Sukhoon Humbert and Fisherman and making his distinctive mark in the industry. This artist recently finished his mandatory military duties and announced a new chapter in his career. In this episode Kuonechan performs his new single “Expression” as well as “Don’t be sad” “How Did You” and more to nourish our souls. Tune in to I’m LIVE and meet this talented musician!

programme.title: I'M LIVE - ALi
programme.desc: Joining us on this week’s I’m LIVE is singer ALi! ALi burst into the music scene in 2005 as a guest vocalist for Leessang. Thanks to her unique voice and expressive vocals she mesmerized the public immediately and then she made her debut as a solo artist in 2009 with the album “After The Love Has Gone.” In the competition program “Immortal Songs” she presented her own covers of various masterpieces including “Leopard of Kilimanjaro” and “I Have a Girlfriend” and gained both popular and critical acclaim. In December last year ALi released the remake album “Adolescence” which is composed of the five songs that had a huge influence on her back in her 20’s and 30’s to share with listeners how she makes the most of the youngest day of her life. In this episode ALi performs “For lovers who hesitate” “Break away” and “Please wait for me” from her latest album as well as “Eraser” and “The way the light.” Tune in to I’m LIVE and meet this.

programme.title: SEGMEN HARMONIKA (1700-1900)
programme.desc:
Harmonika merupakan segmen siaran petang ke malam KENINGAUfm yang menekankan keharmonian emosi, muzik dan kehidupan. Bersiaran dari jam 5 hingga 7 malam, segmen ini menjadi pengiring setia pendengar ketika waktu pulang dari kerja, dalam perjalanan, atau berehat bersama keluarga menjelang malam.

Segmen ini menyajikan lagu-lagu malar segar, balada, nostalgia dan pilihan pendengar yang menenangkan jiwa, diselang-selikan dengan perkongsian santai, refleksi ringan dan kisah kehidupan yang menyentuh perasaan. 

Harmonika turut membuka ruang interaksi dua hala melalui dedikasi lagu, kiriman mesej dan ucapan daripada pendengar, menjadikan segmen ini dekat dan peribadi. Di samping hiburan, segmen ini menyelitkan kata-kata positif, nilai kekeluargaan dan mesej kemanusiaan, sesuai untuk menutup hari dengan rasa damai dan seimbang.

Segmen ini bukan sekadar hiburan muzik, tetapi sebuah ruang harmoni yang menyatukan perasaan, kenangan dan harapan pendengar dalam alunan petang menuju malam.

programme.title: SEGMEN RENTAK SEGAR (0600-0900)
programme.desc: Segmen Rentak Segar – Permulaan Hari dengan Energi Positif di KENINGAUfm! Rentak Segar merupakan segmen siaran Bahasa Malaysia yang membuka tirai pagi di KENINGAUfm, bersiaran setiap hari dari pukul 6:00 hingga 9:00 pagi. Segmen ini menjadi pilihan utama pendengar di pedalaman Sabah untuk memulakan hari dengan maklumat terkini, hiburan, dan motivasi pagi yang segar.

programme.title: SEGMEN DUSUN-KUHOI ARAMAI BOH (0900-1200)
programme.desc: Kuhoi Aramai Boh merupakan segmen siaran bahasa Dusun yang bersifat ceria, mesra komuniti dan sarat nilai budaya, disiarkan setiap pagi dari jam 9 hingga 12 tengah hari. Segmen ini menjadi ruang kebersamaan untuk pendengar berkongsi cerita, gelak tawa, dan maklumat bermanfaat dalam suasana santai seperti berkumpul sesama keluarga.\n\nSepanjang tempoh siaran, pendengar disajikan dengan lagu-lagu Dusun dan tempatan pilihan, perbualan ringan berunsur hiburan, motivasi dan kehidupan seharian, serta perkongsian isu komuniti setempat. Interaksi langsung bersama pendengar melalui panggilan telefon, WhatsApp dan dedikasi lagu mengukuhkan hubungan dua hala antara penyampai dan komuniti.

programme.title: SEGMEN MURUT- PAGAYAMAN TAKAW MONSOI (1200-1500)
programme.desc:
Pagayaman Takaw Monsoi merupakan segmen siaran bahasa Murut yang mengangkat semangatperkongsian dan kebersamaan yang harmoni bersama komuniti. Bersiaran setiap hari dari jam 12 hingga 3 petang.

Segmen ini mengetengahkan lagu-lagu Murut dan tempatan pilihan, perbualan ringan berkenaan kehidupan harian, budaya, adat resam serta kisah komuniti pedalaman, di samping perkongsian maklumat semasa yang dekat dengan realiti pendengar. 

Interaksi dua hala menjadi kekuatan utama Pagayaman Takaw Monsoi melalui panggilan telefon, pesanan WhatsApp dan dedikasi lagu, sekali gus memberi ruang kepada pendengar untuk bersuara, berkongsi cerita dan menyampaikan salam kekeluargaan. Segmen ini turut menyelitkan kata-kata nasihat, nilai murni dan mesej kemasyarakatan, menjadikannya bukan sahaja menghiburkan, malah menyatukan dan memperkukuh jati diri komuniti dikawasan Pedalaman.

programme.title: SEGMEN SANTAI PETANG (1500-1700)
programme.desc:
Santai Petang merupakan segmen siaran yang menemani pendengar KENINGAUfm pada waktu peralihan dari rutin kerja ke suasana petang yang lebih tenang. Bersiaran dari jam 3 hingga 5 petang, segmen ini membawa pendekatan santai, ringan dan menghiburkan, sesuai dinikmati ketika dalam perjalanan pulang, berehat di rumah atau masih di tempat kerja.

Segmen ini menghidangkan lagu-lagu pilihan tempatan dan popular, diselang-selikan dengan sembang santai, perkongsian kisah harian, isu ringan semasa, serta topik-topik dekat dengan kehidupan pendengar.

Interaksi bersama pendengar menjadi elemen utama Santai Petang, melalui kiriman WhatsApp, dedikasi lagu dan respons spontan terhadap pandangan pendengar. Segmen ini turut menyelitkan kata-kata motivasi ringkas, info bermanfaat dan mesej positif, menjadikan ia bukan sekadar hiburan, tetapi juga ruang untuk melepaskan tekanan dan menutup hari dengan emosi yang lebih baik.

Segmen ini turut menyelitkan kata-kata motivasi ringkas, info bermanfaat dan mesej positif, menjadikan ia bukan sekadar hiburan, tetapi juga ruang untuk melepaskan tekanan dan menutup hari dengan emosi yang lebih baik.

programme.title: SEGMEN HARMONIKA (1700-1900)
programme.desc:
Harmonika merupakan segmen siaran petang ke malam KENINGAUfm yang menekankan keharmonian emosi, muzik dan kehidupan. Bersiaran dari jam 5 hingga 7 malam, segmen ini menjadi pengiring setia pendengar ketika waktu pulang dari kerja, dalam perjalanan, atau berehat bersama keluarga menjelang malam.

Segmen ini menyajikan lagu-lagu malar segar, balada, nostalgia dan pilihan pendengar yang menenangkan jiwa, diselang-selikan dengan perkongsian santai, refleksi ringan dan kisah kehidupan yang menyentuh perasaan. 

Harmonika turut membuka ruang interaksi dua hala melalui dedikasi lagu, kiriman mesej dan ucapan daripada pendengar, menjadikan segmen ini dekat dan peribadi. Di samping hiburan, segmen ini menyelitkan kata-kata positif, nilai kekeluargaan dan mesej kemanusiaan, sesuai untuk menutup hari dengan rasa damai dan seimbang.

Segmen ini bukan sekadar hiburan muzik, tetapi sebuah ruang harmoni yang menyatukan perasaan, kenangan dan harapan pendengar dalam alunan petang menuju malam.

programme.title: SANTAI 5-8
programme.desc: Segmen Santai 5-8 mengandungi zon muzik segmen Lagu 60 an pada Isnin Laguku Kuasa Dua pada Selasa Rabu Lagu dan Kenangan Khamis Secangkir Bicara/Nurul Al-Quran dan Jumaat La Khobar. Sabtu dan Ahad segmen Hello Hello MELAKAfm pilihan lagu dan ucapan pendengar

programme.title: GEGAU PAGI 6-10
programme.desc: Seri Pagi dimulakan dengan Bacaan Al-Quran & Terjemahan seterusnya rancangan Permata Hati dan Kapsul Motivasi Jana Minda. Info Cuaca dan Berita MELAKAfm. Info trafik(call out) dan Topik Gegau Pagi interaktif bersama pendengar.Kokenut Shake Dulu Special (Temubual/Zon Iklan menyusul selepasnya. Pada Hari Sabtu pula rancangan Yok Donga Be bersiaran melibatkan tiga negeri Zon Selatan iaitu Melaka, Negeri Sembilan dan Johor secara interaktif. Sementara pada Hari Ahad Mari Berpantun(interaktif)seni budaya warisan kita.

programme.title: Pesona 10-2
programme.desc: Pendengar berpeluang memberi ucapan kepada orang yang tersayang dan membuat permintaan lagu menerusi ruangan Laguku Untukmu, bermula jam 11 pagi. Turut disajikan rancangan Dialog 1:30, program temu bual bersama Jabatan Kerajaan dan agensi-agensi berkaitan dengan memfokuskan topik-topik berkaitan situasi semasa. Rancangan keagamaan seperti Mutiara Ilmu, Fiqh Nisa dan Dari Kamar Syariah pula diserikan pada setiap Jumaat.

programme.title: Panorama 2-5
programme.desc: Santai bersama lagu-lagu tempatan dan antarabangsa terbaik menerusi ruangan 'Zon Muzik setiap Isnin jam 3 petang. Pada setiap Selasa, info-info menarik mengenai kenderaan dikongsikan menerusi rancangan 'Vromm??'. Pendengar juga akan menikmati keindahan warisan budaya negeri Melaka menerusi 'Dondang Sayang' jam 3 petang, Rabu dan 'Persada Pantun' jam 3 petang, Khamis. Turut disajikan rancangan keagamaan seperti 'Secangkir Bicara: Biar Santai Janji Sampai' dan 'Nurul Quran' \"La khobar\"pada setiap Jumaat. Sabtu dan Ahad diserikan dengan Silang Budaya/Stesen Berkembar Suara Bertemu Suara Satu Suara Satu Jiwa.

programme.title: Relaks Mfm 8-12
programme.desc: Hangatkan malam Isnin anda dengan seleksi lagu terbaik menerusi 'Janji Rock' bersama DJ Lia. 'Salam Namaste' pula menemui anda setiap Selasa dengan seleksi lagu-lagu Bollywood dan Hindustan. 'Layan Muzik' akan menghiburkan malam Rabu dengan Santai Buskers dan juga Dari Studio Muzik. Seleksi lagu-lagu ketuhanan melayari Khamis malam Jumaat anda. Turut Hangatkan malam Isnin anda dengan seleksi lagu terbaik menerusi 'Janji Rock' bersama DJ Lia. 'Salam Namaste' pula menemui anda setiap Selasa dengan seleksi lagu-lagu Bollywood dan Hindustan. 'Layan Muzik' akan menghiburkan malam Rabu dengan rancangan IN-TREND pilihan lagu-lagu baru. Seleksi lagu-lagu dalam Senada Duet melayari malam Khamis anda Malam Bunga Bunga Cinta untuk yang curhat pada malam Jumaat bersama DJ Ain. Turut disajikan 'Waronk Dangdut pada Sabtu dan Syok 80-90 pada Ahad.

programme.title: KONA MAI 2026
programme.desc: Rehatkan minda anda pada penghujung hari bersama Shah, Faruk & Mimie dalam segmen KONA MAI. Segmen ini membawakan pilihan lagu santai, pengisian rohani, serta seleksi lagu-lagu kesukaan anda di Tapaw Lagu @ Kafe Muzik. Sebelum melelapkan mata, nikmati alunan lagu-lagu melankolik terkini, bahasa Melayu, Inggeris, dan Indonesia untuk menemani malam anda dengan penuh kedamaian.

programme.title: GENG PAGI MUTIARA
programme.desc: Mulakan Pagi anda dengan penuh bersemangat bersama Chombi dan Bambam!\\n Segmen ini menyajikan gabungan lengkap untuk memulakan hari anda dengan positif—daripada pengisian rohani menerusi bacaan Al-Quran, nasyid, dan Santai Nurani, hinggalah kepada berita sahih, laporan trafik semasa, tajuk-tajuk akhbar utama, serta topik pagi yang santai dan menghiburkan. Jangan lupa layan lagu-lagu permintaan anda dalam slot Layan Pagi sebelum melangkah ke tengah hari!

programme.title: FOKUS MUTIARA
programme.desc: Sambil buat kerja atau berehat, penyampai kami Azie, Elly , Mimie & Fazrinah sedia menemani dengan pelbagai maklumat berguna dan hiburan menarik. Dapatkan petua serta tips gaya hidup serta pelbagai perkongsian harian yang terkini. Nikmati juga kelainan irama Bollywood menerusi Syoknya Hindi & mengimbau memori menerusi Everlasting Memory dengan lagu retro Inggeris terbaik serta laporan berita Warta Mutiara secara langsung bagi memastikan anda sentiasa peka dengan isu semasa.

programme.title: PETANG KREW
programme.desc: Petang anda pastinya tidak hambar bersama gandingan serasi Amin , Que , Mimie dan Fazrinah! Sambil melayan perjalanan pulang dari kerja, dapatkan pengisian Mutiara Ilmu, tips keusahawanan dalam Biz On Air, serta bincangkan pelbagai Isu hangat dan menarik menerusi Ralet Cheq. Tak lengkap petang anda tanpa menguji minda dalam peraduan Teka Tiara Nyanyi bersama kemaskini trafik dan berita terkini.

programme.title: Zoo Vet At Large
programme.desc: Dr. Matt has to find out why Izzy, a cockatoo, has plucked herself almost bare and he performs an urgent operation to save the life of Jerry, the pregnant corn snake. He puts two fat cats on a regime to lose weight while at Flamingoland, he faces the challenge of knocking out a big cat for a spot of surgery.

programme.title: My House And Other Animals
programme.desc: Meet the modern-day Dr Doolittles with a passion for all creatures great and small: the unsung heroes of the wildlife world, whose homes have become havens for every animal imaginable.

programme.title: Cute Pet At Home
programme.desc: Ali the elephant at Shoushan Zoo, carries the childhood memories of many children, both young and old. Although he is now 49 years old, he is still energetic under the care of the keepers. Once the new zoo is completed, the public will be able to see "Ali" again. When the caregiver helps Ali take a shower, Ali will take the opportunity to replenish his body with water; sometimes he will step on water in the pool and use his nose to enjoy the fun of playing in the water. There are currently only three African elephants in Taiwan. In addition to Ali, the other two are in the Taipei City Zoo. Because African elephants are endangered wild animals, their import and export are strictly controlled. If these three elephants die in the future, Taiwan may no longer see any African elephants. Shoushan Zoo vows to take good care of "Ali" so that "Ali's" heartwarming story can continue, and shoulder the mission of life education, so that everyone's visit to the Shoushan Zoo is the starting point of happy memories. In addition to Ali the elephant, Shoushan Zoo currently has two white rhinos, male "Xiqi" from the Taipei City Zoo and female "Baby" who was bred naturally in the zoo. White rhino "Xiqi" was loaned to Shoushan Zoo in hope that he could successfully mate with the female white rhino "Baby" to raise the white rhino population.

programme.title: They Wait in the Dark
programme.desc: Amy and her adopted son Adrian flee from her abusive ex-girlfriend Judith. Seeking refuge in an abandoned farmhouse in Amy's Kansas hometown, they confront a supernatural evil force from her dark past that haunts Adrian. As Judith pursues them, Amy and Adrian must face the dangers both outside and within the house.

programme.title: White
programme.desc: As a boy, Xie Yi Zhong performed a spirit-summoning ritual and accidentally invoked Bai Wu Chang, the White Reaper, triggering a tragedy. Years later, he returns home to find his hometown plagued by eerie events and his loved ones' lives at stake. Will he dare summon the spirit again to confront the evil forces?

programme.title: Model Family

When a woman he likes seems to be bullied by her son, he goes about setting things right for her, even resorting to turning himself into a cold-blooded serial killer…

programme.title: The Windmill Massacre
programme.desc: Jennifer joins a tour to explore the renowned windmills of the Netherlands. As their tour coach breaks down on the way, they seek refuge in a creepy shed near a sinister windmill with a dark history. When some tour members suddenly disappear, Jennifer discovers a shared secret among them, linking their fates in a chilling revelation.

programme.title: Chapter 1 Mae Nak Reborn
programme.desc: Mae Nak the ghost wife returns to take revenge for a pregnant woman who is sexually assaulted and loses her baby. No one can identify the assailant except Mae Nak, who turns into an evil spirit in order to punish the assailant for his evil deeds.

programme.title: The Case of Disappearances
programme.desc: In Misty Village, the adopted son Wen Jie is haunted by a recurring nightmare. He delves into a series of disappearance cases in the village to seek his true identity. As more villagers die mysteriously, belief in the curse of Emperor Jing Lung intensifies. Wen Jie teams up with the security chief to unveil the conspiracy and protect the villagers.

programme.title: Evie
programme.desc: When young Evie discovers a cursed necklace washed up on the beach, she is unaware of the malevolent force tied to it. As the necklace's dark power begins to grip her, she inadvertently awakens a deadly water demon intent on claiming her and everyone she holds dear.

programme.title: Detrimental
programme.desc: You Ji Ren is a blind man who works at a factory on an outlying island. When the factory is cut off from the outside world by a hurricane one day, a monster appears and turns whoever sees it into black shadows. As You cannot see the monster, he is able to help his other co-workers escape safely and fight to kill the monster.

programme.title: 3AM
programme.desc: A taxi driver who is constantly judging others by his own standards, also reads into their every move and sets out to help ‘victims’ in his own way. programme.title: The Windmill Massacre

programme.title: Malee
programme.desc: When four best friends reunite for a funeral at an ancient estate, a reckless act with a cursed Manohra dancer's headdress awakens a vengeful spirit that begins to haunt and follow them relentlessly. As paranormal phenomena escalate, they are forced to confront the estate's dark secrets in a desperate struggle for survival.

programme.title: Anak Perjanjian Syaitan 2
programme.desc: Haunted since childhood, orphan Azlinda believes her torment stems from her parents' dark history. Her friends Zurina, Wati, and Ustaz join forces to end her suffering, but a malevolent demon interrupts their efforts. Will Azlinda succeed in severing the cursed ties that bind her, or is she destined to remain trapped in darkness forever?

programme.title: Apartment 212
programme.desc: Escaping an abusive past, Jennifer moves into Apartment 212 for a fresh start, only to wake each day with painful bite marks. She soon discovers an ancient parasite that feeds on human flesh lurking within the walls. As attacks intensify, she must confront a nightmare more terrifying than her past before it consumes her.

Berani, jujur dan bertekad untuk membuktikan kebolehannya, Gordon perlu berdepan dengan permainan politik kotor dalam sistem keadilan Gotham, selain kemunculan penjahat berbahaya. Kimmy bertemu dengan Titus Andromedon, seorang pelakon Broadway dan menyewa bilik daripadanya. Lakonan : Ellie Kemper, Jane Krakowski, Tituss Burgess, Tina Fey, Carol Kane dan ramai lagi.

programme.title: Gran Turismo
programme.desc: Berdasarkan kisah benar yang luar biasa, filem ini mengisahkan Jann Mardenborough, seorang remaja yang handal bermain simulator Gran Turismo. Apabila Nissan melancarkan pertandingan mencari bakat baharu, Jann terpilih untuk menyertai kem latihan elit di bawah bimbingan bekas pelumba, Jack Salter. Daripada kerusi gaming ke kokpit kereta lumba sebenar berkelajuan 320 km/j, Jann mesti berdepan tentangan keluarga, persaingan sengit dan bahaya maut di litar lumba. Dia perlu mempertaruhkan nyawa di perlumbaan legenda '24 Hours of Le Mans' untuk membuktikan kepada dunia bahawa dia bukan sekadar seorang pemain video game, tetapi seorang pelumba sejati. Lakonan : Archie Madekwe, David Harbour, Orlando Bloom, Takehiro Hira, Darren Barnet.

programme.title: Chicago Med
programme.desc: Selepas kemalangan kereta, Dr. Natalie Manning mengalami kecederaan otak dan Dr. Halstead dipenuhi rasa bersalah. Kecurigaan timbul apabila Phillip mendakwa dirinya tunang Natalie. Sementara itu, Dr. Connor Rhodes berdepan tragedi peribadi apabila Dr. Ava Bekker membunuh diri selepas mengaku menyebabkan kematian ayahnya. Maggie bergelut dengan diagnosis kanser, Dr. Choi dan April berdepan ujian hubungan, manakala Dr. Charles kembali awal dari bulan madu untuk merawat pesakit yang disyaki menghidap skizofrenia. Lakonan : Nick Gehlfuss, Yaya DaCosta, Torrey DeVitto, Colin Donnell dan ramai lagi.

programme.title: HANYA UNTUK DIA
programme.desc: Ain menolak lamaran Dr Zafran kerana mahukan calon keluarga, walau sesekali terfikirkannya. Tanpa pengetahuan Ain, keluarganya mula mengatur jodoh mereka, sementara Dr Zafran terus berusaha keras memenangi hati Ain.

programme.title: SETELAH KU DIMILIKI

programme.title: SETELAH KU DIMILIKI

programme.title: SEOUL CINTA
programme.desc: Raisha cuba menjernihkan hubungan dengan Daniel dengan memujuk Daniel akan tetapi Daniel sudah tawar hati dengannya. Ini menyebabkan Raisha semakin berdendam dengan Azra, dan dia yakin Azra dan Kiki adalah orang yang sama.

programme.title: CINTA TANPA HENTI
programme.desc: Sumayyah tak sangka Zarif membeli galeri tersebut. Menurut Zarif dia memang tidak pandai melukis seperti Hisyam tetapi dia pandai berniaga untuk mencari untung tak perlu bekerja keras untuk memiliki galeri lukisan sendiri.

programme.title: LELAKI ITU
programme.desc: Khairullah amat sedih atas nasib yang menimpa Batrisya sambil meraung menyalahkan Qaidah. Bainah dan Bahiyah turut menyalahkan Qaidah atas keruntuhan keluarga mereka. Imani menasihati Sarena untuk mendapatkan haknya.

programme.title: WANITA SYURGA
programme.desc: Tuan Mokhtar membimbing Farah kejalan yang benar. Tanpa rasa malu Amar sengaja mencari pelbagai alasan untuk mendekati Ardini. Dia asyik merendah-rendahkan Lukman dan berterusan memanipulasi perasaan Ardini.

programme.title: KE MANA HILANG CINTA
programme.desc: Terbongkar rahsia rupanya Sya dan Azizah dalang pada penyiasatan dan tangkapan terhadap Jaris. Namun Aidil masih bebas dan kini dia tekad membalas dendam. Bahrin menyelesaikan masalah kes saman antara Rashdan dan Aidil.

programme.title: SCARLET HEART
programme.desc: Hae Soo mula menjauhi Putera Wang So akibat bayangan masa depan yang menakutkan, manakala Wang So meminta Hae Soo sebagai ganjaran diraja. Di tengah manipulasi politik Permaisuri Yoo, Wang So nekad meluahkan cintanya.

programme.title: HANYA UNTUK DIA

RANCANGAN KATA DIRIK
programme.desc: Rancangan Kata Dirik menggunakan format berkomunikasi dalam Bahasa BIdayuh Salako. Racangan ini melibatkan dua orang tetamu jemputan dari kaum Salako yang berpengalaman dan mempunyai banyak pengetahuan mengenai budaya dan adat resam masyarakat Bidayuh Salako. Penggunaan muzik tradisional Salako (Wek Jonggan) pada permulaan dan pengakhiran rancangan. Disiarkan setiap hari Khamis jam 8 malam dalam Segmen Nganchang Putue. Siaran pertama ialah pada minggu pertama dan ketiga manakala siaran ulangan pada minggu kedua dan keempat. Durasi rancangan ialah 30 minit.
